ComfyJot.Settings.DefaultBrushSize.name: Default brush size
ComfyJot.Settings.DefaultBrushSize.tooltip: Sets the initial brush size when the Comfy Jot overlay is opened.

ComfyJot.Settings.ShowExistingOnLoad.name: Auto-show saved notes on workflow load
ComfyJot.Settings.ShowExistingOnLoad.tooltip: Opens the Comfy Jot overlay automatically when the workflow already contains saved annotations.
